version.description: The Groundwork version that installed or last upgraded this project's .groundwork/ files. Written by `groundwork init` and `groundwork upgrade`; `groundwork doctor` compares it with the CLI.

approvalMode.description: per-card: the human approves every card before it is committed. per-phase: cards commit after review passes, and the human approves the phase as a whole.

tokenBudget.description: Maximum estimated tokens for files loaded in every session (AGENTS.md plus always-on adapter files). Checked by `groundwork doctor`.

guards.description: Guards to run before shell commands and file writes, by file name in .groundwork/guards/ (without .mjs). Empty means none run.

commands.description: Shell commands the agents run. Leave a command empty if the project doesn't have it.
